Terms of Service

This forum is run by a small group of volunteers. By joining it you agree to follow our Code of Conduct.

Your content

Anything you post here is published under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 licence. You may not post content that you do not have the right to share.

Memberships

Supporting members pay a yearly fee. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each year unless you cancel it from your account page.

Moderation

Posts that break the Code of Conduct are flagged. Action will be taken, either automatically or by moderator intervention, depending on the number of flags a post receives.

Search engines

Public categories are visible to everyone. You may crawl the forum to index it for a publicly available search engine, if you run one. Search engine robots read our sitemap to find new topics.

Changes

We may update these terms. We will announce every change in the Announcements category.
